title: AI consulting in Show Low, AZ | Creosote Labs
meta_description: AI consulting for Show Low and White Mountains businesses. One-day operations review at $3,000, implementation quoted from it, training $1,000 per person.
intro: Businesses in Show Low include medical and dental practices, contractors and trades, retail stores, and the restaurants and lodging that serve visitors to the White Mountains. Many of them run on QuickBooks, Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, an industry system such as ServiceTitan, Dentrix, or Toast, and a set of Word and Excel documents that staff fill out by hand. AI consulting applies wherever those documents and customer messages take staff time to produce.

Creosote Labs serves businesses in Show Low and the surrounding White Mountains. An engagement starts with a one-day operations review, on site, that documents how the business currently runs and identifies where AI tools would save time. The written assessment includes a quote for each recommendation. Implementation means setting up the tools the business already pays for, such as Copilot, Gemini, or Claude, with its own templates and documents, and then training staff on their own work.
projects: An operations review of a Show Low contractor's office that maps how estimates, change orders, and invoices move from the field to QuickBooks.
A Copilot setup in a medical practice's Microsoft 365 tenant that drafts referral letters and patient instructions from the practice's own templates.
A Gemini workflow for a lodging business that answers common guest email inquiries from an approved set of policies and rates.
A written assessment for a retail store showing which of its weekly reports could be produced automatically from Square and QuickBooks data.
A staff training day for a property management office on using Claude to draft owner statements and lease renewal notices from its Buildium records.

faqs.q: Do we need to buy new AI software before the review?
faqs.a: No. The review looks at what the business already has, including the AI features included in Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. If a paid tool would help, the assessment says which one and what it costs.

faqs.q: How is AI consulting priced for a Show Low business?
faqs.a: The one-day operations review is $3,000. It produces a written assessment with a quote for each recommendation, implementation is priced from those quotes, and team training is $1,000 per person.

faqs.q: What do we need to have ready for the review day?
faqs.a: Access to the owner and the staff who do the day-to-day work, and examples of the documents the business produces, such as estimates, intake forms, invoices, and customer emails. The assessment is delivered within the week.
